# Colophon

The last chapter of the book, carrying no placement marker: it grows no index
section, and it is the one chapter that has seen every other chapter's record,
so it is where an unplaced or a doubled index section is reported. It sits
after `four.qmd` so that the chapter which gains a placement marker between two
renders is never the chapter that draws the report about the doubling.

A third term for the index no marker names: [Escutcheon]{.index index="gamma"}.
